sessions.content: [JWT Authentication] Architecture finalized. Standard: 15-minute expiry via PyJWT+Redis. All components must comply.
[JWT Authentication] Peripheral note: Upgraded dev dependency: prettier 3.1 -> 3.2. Reformatted affected files.
[JWT Authentication] Temporary override: Due to PyJWT+Redis issues, we are relaxing the constraint to 60-minute expiry for the current sprint only.
[JWT Authentication] Team reviewed alternatives. Confirmed 900-second validity window satisfies our requirements. Tech stack: PyJWT+Redis.
[JWT Authentication] FINAL for production: temporary override reverted. Enforcing 15-minute expiry globally. No exceptions.

[Database Schema] FINAL for production: temporary override reverted. Enforcing UUID primary keys globally. No exceptions.

[Microservice Context] FINAL for production: temporary override reverted. Enforcing strict domain boundary globally. No exceptions.

[CI/CD Pipeline] FINAL for production: temporary override reverted. Enforcing require 2 PR approvals globally. No exceptions.

[Observability Stack] FINAL for production: temporary override reverted. Enforcing 10% trace sampling globally. No exceptions.

[Distributed Caching] FINAL for production: temporary override reverted. Enforcing 5-minute TTL cache-aside globally. No exceptions.
